$comment: Per-file strictNullChecks allowlist (docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md §8). The whole-project flip costs ~170 sites with no per-file granularity, so modules graduate ONE AT A TIME: the main tsconfig EXCLUDES every file listed here, and each must hold strictNullChecks + noUncheckedIndexedAccess clean. Graduated so far: the whole client half — qr.ts (pure QR math, zero imports, verified by a jsQR decode round-trip) and the render/form layer (cards/account-form/panel-page; failure mode is a mis-drawn panel, never a locked account). Next in line: the non-red-line host modules (store/catalog/parse); LAST: the ~40 login-path sites (routes/token-store/auth/publish), which need frame-by-frame review like the store-baseline split. A graduating file moves into `include` here AND gets added to the main config's `exclude` — both in the same commit, or typecheck-gate runs it twice under different rules.
